title: Computosis
description: This mod adds very bad computers. Yes.
body:
# Quick explaination
this is just a fake computer mod that has very _VERY_ bad graphics.
# Items
Computer - crafted with gold, redstone and iron.
MC-DOZ boot disk - made with iron and nugget red dye

# _Features_
PC- can insert otherside or MC-DOZ diskette
MC-DOZ commands -
WhoLetTheDogsOut - summons 3 dogs
help - gives you 1 rotten flesh
DUUM Diskette - use with pc to play DUUM!
